required.requirement: Compose SupervisorAuthority against the accepted worker-pin/release-retirement and Attempt/install lease CAS authorities; claim, holds, interrupt and release must remain exact, idempotent and transactional. interrupt_attempt must report the reconciled terminal outcome so a worker claim is never released before the exact Attempt is durably reconciled.

Compose ImmutableRouteSource from the accepted Generation member and verified PackageStore without introducing a mutable route or second truth source. Every route must provide four absolute, non-reparse, disjoint roots: immutable package, content-addressed venv, mutable working directory and exact <plugin_id>/generations/<data_generation_id> private-data directory containing plugin.db. Any public worker API that exposes plugin.db remains P0-owned; do not substitute an ambient mutable path.

Select and probe a trusted CPython 3.12 base interpreter, compose OfflineVenvProvisioner.ensure() before publishing a worker route, and require the target interpreter identity probe to pass before and after install and after non-replacing publication. Never fall back to the host application's default interpreter.

Persist host/lifecycle identity in the existing Core authority and run idempotent startup reconciliation after confirmed host loss. First interrupt/reconcile the exact Attempt and revoke or recover the exact install lease; only after both reach authoritative terminal outcomes may the reconciler exact-CAS release the old worker pin. Repeated or concurrent reconciliation must not affect a replacement lifecycle and must not create a Supervisor-local authority database.

Commit each Host mutation and its canonical first response in the existing durable operation ledger in one transaction. Inject the exact-request durable_host_replay resolver into PluginProcessSupervisor; after local bounded replay eviction it must supply the byte-equivalent canonical frame on ACK loss, while unknown or different stale requests fail closed. Supervisor owns only bounded transport replay state, not the durable mutation ledger.

On Windows compose the contained IsolatedVenvProcessFactory path: suspended spawn, fail-closed Job Object assignment with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, bounded stdin writer and bounded stdout/stderr drain. Do not substitute a parent-PID-only process adapter.
Mount only /__plotpilot/plugin-worker/<release_id>/<bundle_hash>/worker.js and serve bytes returned by the live-pinned lookup.
Acquire and continuously hold the exact UI/worker release pin across lookup and response completion; release it only after the response can no longer read package bytes.

Apply the frozen CSP/media type and compose supervisor tick/start/stop with Core runtime decisions. Timeouts may terminate only the exact release/worker lifecycle and never grant or restore authority; live worker, Attempt and install decisions remain Core lease/CAS decisions.
